title: Understanding FOIL
text:
FOIL stands for:
- **F**irst terms: multiply the first term of each bracket
- **O**uter terms: multiply the outer terms
- **I**nner terms: multiply the inner terms
- **L**ast terms: multiply the last term of each bracket

title: Calculate Each Product
text:
For $(2x + 3)(x - 5)$:

- First: $2x \times x = 2x^2$
- Outer: $2x \times (-5) = -10x$
- Inner: $3 \times x = 3x$
- Last: $3 \times (-5) = -15$
